name: Malmö University
summary: University in Malmö, across the Öresund from Copenhagen; six English bachelor's, five in politics and society plus Interaction Design.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry and covers the English 6 and Civics 1b these programmes ask for: no extra subjects.

dates.label: January round opens (only if you already hold your IB Diploma)
January round closes (not for final-year IB students)
January round: documents and proof of EU/EEA citizenship due
April round opens (EU/EEA), if a programme runs it; Malmö says 16 March
April round: proof of EU/EEA citizenship (fee exemption) due
April round: final IB results due via the IB Result Service (recipient code UHR)
April round: reply to your offer or lose the place

programmes.name: European Studies - Politics, Societies and Cultures, Bachelor's Programme
programmes.about: Europe and the EU past and present, and their place in the world, studied through political science, history, geography, law, culture and literature.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 April round: 66% of places on grades (your IB converted to Sweden's scale, max 22.5), 34% on the SweSAT. Malmö has not yet announced its April 2027 round.

programmes.name: Human Rights
programmes.about: What human rights are and how they are interpreted and used in law, politics and philosophy: how they are enforced and monitored, and how conflicts between rights are resolved.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 April round: 66% of places on grades (your IB converted to Sweden's scale, max 22.5), 34% on the SweSAT. Malmö has not yet announced its April 2027 round.

programmes.name: Interaction Design
programmes.about: Designing experiences with products, services and environments that are useful and usable but also expressive and desirable, building a repertoire of design methods, skills and theory.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 April round: 66% of places on grades (your IB converted to Sweden's scale, max 22.5), 34% on the SweSAT. Malmö has not yet announced its April 2027 round.

programmes.name: International Migration and Ethnic Relations
programmes.about: Global migration and migration policy, refugees and asylum law, segregation, discrimination, integration and social cohesion, preparing you for work on migration and diversity.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 April round: 66% of places on grades (your IB converted to Sweden's scale, max 22.5), 34% on the SweSAT. Malmö has not yet announced its April 2027 round.

programmes.name: International Relations
programmes.about: Analyse current world politics: peace and security, cooperation and conflict, foreign policy and aid, with a semester kept free for exchange, an internship or other courses.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 April round: 66% of places on grades (your IB converted to Sweden's scale, max 22.5), 34% on the SweSAT. Malmö has not yet announced its April 2027 round.

programmes.name: Peace and Conflict Studies
programmes.about: Why armed conflict and organised violence arise and how they end, from systemic to grassroots views, drawing on political science, history, law, anthropology and philosophy.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 April round: 66% of places on grades (your IB converted to Sweden's scale, max 22.5), 34% on the SweSAT. Malmö has not yet announced its April 2027 round.

notes: Places go 66% on school grades and 34% on the SweSAT; Malmö says the SweSAT is only in Swedish and is in no way mandatory.
International Relations and Peace and Conflict Studies keep one semester free for exchange abroad, an internship or courses elsewhere.

Malmö advises international students to apply in January, but that is for diploma holders: still at school, you need the April round (EU/EEA), and Malmö has not yet said which programmes run in it for 2027.
